description: Consolidate many small leftover token balances (dust) into one token (default USDC) on an EVM chain. Pass the dust list (token address + amount — you know your own balances); returns a plan of unsigned swaps, gas-positive legs only, with the whole tiny sweep fee riding ONE leg. Non-custodial: approve each leg's approvalTarget and sign. Base/Arbitrum/Optimism/Ethereum/BNB Chain/Polygon/Avalanche.
